title: Multilingual and Multi-Accent Jailbreaking of Audio LLMs
reasoning: The paper evaluates and benchmarks the ethical alignment and safety of Audio LLMs by measuring Jailbreak Success Rates (JSR). It utilizes a dataset of harmful instructions to test whether models bypass safety filters and generate unethical or harmful content, using the Llama Guard 3 safety policy as a classifier for moral and ethical adherence.
